name: spana-bridge
description: Opt-in in-app test bridge for Spana web-first cross-platform E2E testing (Web, Capacitor iOS/Android, Electron, Electrobun)

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/capacitor.ts src/electron.ts src/protocol.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --sourcemap && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --noEmit false --rootDir src
